title: CHORD
subtitle: Learning to interpolate feasible designs
format: 1620 x 1440 transparent RGBA PNG; one shared image for light and dark backgrounds
example: Archived CHORD self-consistent interpolation example used for the paper, pair 18, latent dimension 16.
projection: PCA of 90 raw boundary coefficients; not latent-code PCA.
cloud: 20,000 samples from the released 500k surrogate corpus, random seed 7; every second sample displayed. Includes both feasible and infeasible designs.
curve: Smooth visual guide through five actual projected samples, not a dense decoder evaluation or a continuous-feasibility claim.
boundaries: Exact archived three-field-period decoded boundaries with shared camera and scale. Thumbnails are offset from the matching markers for readability.
